approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 6  Chapter 510
 
      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 2311-A, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to amend the public health law, in relation to prohibiting
        charges for the issuance of a  certificate  of  still  birth  or
        pregnancy loss"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This  bill  would amend the Public Health Law to prohibit the issuance
of fees for a certificate of still birth or pregnancy loss.
 
  I support the goals of the bill, which would ensure that no  financial
barrier stands between parents receiving a certificate of still birth or
pregnancy  loss,  the receipt of which can help ease the pain of parents
dealing with such loss. However, the bill reflected  incorrect  versions
of  the  underlying  statutes  and  amended the incorrect section of the
Public Health Law, both of which should be corrected.
 
  I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to enact these chang-
es in the upcoming legislative session. On the basis of this  agreement,
I am pleased to sign this bill into law.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Prohibits charging a fee for the issuance of a certificate of still birth or pregnancy loss.
